scientific_question: Among response-blind Palearctic non-Lepidoptera source-target pairs, does greater similarity of LGM climatic opportunity predict more similar post-IBD spatial genetic differentiation beyond present climate, geographic co-opportunity, lineage and sampling imbalance?

empirical_species_geometry.starting_species: exact species and disjoint source/target roles retained in the frozen v0.3 relation design after GBIF and current-climate validity gates
empirical_species_geometry.panel_selection: for each species, choose the COI-family panel with most exact unique header-matched localities, then more aligned FASTA headers, then lexicographic locus identifier; identical to the response-blind Palearctic panel census rule
empirical_species_geometry.realm_clip: retain only selected exact genetic localities intersecting the frozen RESOLVE 2017 Palearctic union before graph reconstruction
empirical_species_geometry.coordinate_deduplication: exact latitude-longitude uniqueness before graph construction
empirical_species_geometry.survivor_rule: If any relation-design species fails response-blind Palearctic genetic-geometry or character-mask support, remove only those unsupported species, require at least 20 total with at least 9 source and 9 target clusters, rebuild the exact dyad predictor subset, and rerun the frozen v0.3 TTF-Q on that survivor geometry before nucleotide identity opening. No genetic response is opened unless the survivor TTF-Q also passes.

genetic_response.sequence_identity: opened once only after exact authorization
genetic_response.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance over jointly canonical A/C/G/T alignment columns
genetic_response.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean over every valid cross-locality sequence-pair p-distance
genetic_response.edge_response: locality-pair p-distance on the frozen Palearctic-clipped density-scaled kNN edge
genetic_response.source_training_response: post-IBD turnover rank orthogonalized against within-source edge-length rank
genetic_response.source_to_target_score: T_st = Spearman correlation between source-only TTF field prediction and target post-IBD turnover

relational_model.response: directed T_st in exact v0.3 relation-design dyad order
relational_model.predictors_must_be_loaded_from: the exact TTF-Q-qualified v0.3 relation design; do not recompute or substitute predictors after identity opening
relational_model.covariance: two-way source/target cluster-robust sandwich with dyad-intersection subtraction and finite-cluster corrections, using ttf.relational_dyadic.prepare_dyadic_regression and batch_primary_test

one_shot_rules: Do not alter species, source/target roles, dyads, LGM/current relation definitions, controls, climate assets, genetic panel selection, Palearctic clip, graph rule, IBD adjustment, kernel, covariance, alpha or decision rule after nucleotide identity opening.
Do not replace R_LGM with a thresholded refugium overlap, another time slice, another palaeoclimate product, a taxonomic subgroup, interaction or alternate predictor after seeing T_st or beta_LGM.
A technical post-opening failure may be repaired only if the scientific bytes and rules are unchanged and the repair is frozen before the repaired result is inspected.
